## Deployment ownership

- Production deployment is not performed from this PR.
- User approval applies to merge.
- Merge to `main` triggers Cloudflare Pages Git automatic production deployment.
- Web Developer and Local Validator must not run `wrangler pages deploy`, direct upload, dashboard retry, cache purge, or production configuration changes.
- Web CTO verifies the automatic production deployment after merge.
- Manual deployment requires a separate operational incident and explicit user approval.

## Checklist

- [ ] Exact base/head verified
- [ ] Allowed paths only
- [ ] No unrelated dirty files
- [ ] Tests verify behavior and failure paths
- [ ] Tests and build commands do not deploy or mutate Cloudflare production
- [ ] No secrets committed or logged
- [ ] PR remains Draft until CTO review
- [ ] Local validation completed or explicitly not required
- [ ] Automatic preview commit matches tested commit when a preview exists
- [ ] No manual preview or production deployment was performed
- [ ] PR body matches actual diff and evidence

## Status

Developer status:

- [ ] READY FOR CTO RE-REVIEW — DO NOT MERGE
- [ ] BLOCKED — DO NOT MERGE

CTO final status:

- [ ] NOT REVIEWED
- [ ] READY
- [ ] CONDITIONALLY READY
- [ ] NOT READY
- [ ] BLOCKED

User merge approval:

- [ ] NOT GRANTED
- [ ] GRANTED

개발자는 Developer status만 갱신합니다. CTO final status와 User merge approval는 각각 웹 CTO와 사용자·제품 책임자만 갱신할 수 있으며, 개발자가 대신 체크해서는 안 됩니다. Production verification은 merge 후 자동 deployment를 대상으로 웹 CTO가 별도로 수행합니다.
